run_metadata.coverage_summary: Discovery was performed via WebSearch only. This cloud session's network policy blocks direct page fetches: WebFetch returns getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for every non-allowlisted host (all tender portals, buyer sites and aggregators), and the egress proxy only permits package registries, GitHub and Anthropic endpoints, so no tender detail page, portal listing or specification document could be opened directly. All findings therefore come from search-engine result summaries and are captured at HEADLINE level only - deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, values and contacts could not be extracted and are left null/empty. Unlike several recent runs, extended web searches this run surfaced a good crop of genuinely current opportunities with November 2026 closing dates across Tier 1 (Commonwealth/DFAT, NSW buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, SA DIT, ACT) and Tier 2 (Goulburn Valley Water, Mallee CMA, Southern Metropolitan Cemeteries Trust, St Vincent's health, plus local councils via VendorPanel). Tier 3 (private sector) was queried (SAP Business Network Discovery, SAP Ariba supplier portals, EstimateOne subcontractor packages, Airservices Ariba) but no publicly-visible corporate RFx was found - those channels are registration- or invitation-gated, so only the portals are recorded in discovered_sources and no corporate tenders were invented. WA, Tasmania and NT yielded no closing dates that could be confirmed from search summaries and are reported as gaps.
gaps: WebFetch / direct page fetch is blocked in this session (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for all non-allowlisted hosts). No tender detail page, portal search result page, or specification document could be opened - so EVERY tender is headline-level only and all are counted in entries_pending_detail. A future run with egress to *.gov.au and buyer domains (or an authenticated portal session) is needed to extract deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, values and contacts.

AusTender (tenders.gov.au), NSW buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, Tenders WA, Tenders SA/Buying4SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL and ACT Tenders are JavaScript-rendered portals that could not be read directly; Tier 1 coverage relied on search-engine summaries rather than the live portals or their feeds/APIs.

Western Australia: search summaries referenced possible November 2026 items (e.g. a Cunderdin community mural and a Fremantle Hospital transformer replacement) but did not clearly confirm these as closing dates, so no WA tender was recorded to avoid fabrication. Tenders WA needs a direct/authenticated pass.

Tasmania (tenders.tas.gov.au) and Northern Territory (QTOL, tendersonline.nt.gov.au): no open opportunity with a confirmed November 2026 closing date could be surfaced from search summaries this run; deferred to a future run.
Queensland (QTenders / supply.qld.gov.au): no confirmed November 2026 closing date surfaced for a state-agency tender this run (only a council M365 item via VendorPanel); deferred to a future run.

Tier 3 private sector: SAP Business Network Discovery, SAP Ariba supplier portals (Woolworths/Coles/BHP/Rio/Fortescue/Airservices), EstimateOne and major-buyer Coupa/Ariba channels are registration- or invitation-gated; no publicly-visible corporate RFx was found. Invitation-only consultancy/panel RFPs are out of scope and were not fabricated. Capturing corporate opportunities requires authenticated supplier accounts.

Several items (SA DIT packages, NSW OSINT/Dept Customer Service, some council items) were first spotted via third-party aggregators used only as a discovery signal; they are recorded against the buyer's own government portal, but closing dates/status still need verification on the official portal.

The NSW 'Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) Capability' (Dept Customer Service, ~12 Nov 2026) and a Sutherland Shire HVAC contractor panel (~9 Nov 2026) were seen only via aggregator snippets with stale/old age metadata and could not be confirmed on the official portal, so were not recorded as tenders.
recommended_seed_additions: Banyule City Council tenders (VIC, via VendorPanel) - https://www.banyule.vic.gov.au/Business/Tenders-and-contracts
Town of Gawler tenders/quotations (SA, via VendorPanel) - https://www.gawler.sa.gov.au/council/tenders
Southern Metropolitan Cemeteries Trust procurement (VIC, via Buying for Victoria) - https://www.smct.org.au/about-us/procurement
Taronga Conservation Society Australia procurement (NSW, via buy.nsw) - https://taronga.org.au
Goulburn Valley Water (VIC water corporation) - active on Buying for Victoria; worth tracking as a recurring Tier 2 buyer
Mallee Catchment Management Authority (VIC) - publishes environmental/engineering RFTs via Buying for Victoria
